subject: Private Ways in Medford
overview: The committee met with DPW Commissioner Tim McGivern and city legal counsel to review the statutory limits, municipal responsibilities, and service delivery constraints governing private ways. The council voted to receive the report and place it on file.

items.title: Discussion on Private Ways (Paper 23-314)
items.summary: Attorneys from KP Law and DPW Commissioner McGivern outlined state law and city ordinances regarding emergency repairs, plowing, tree maintenance, traffic controls, and the high financial and legal barriers to converting private ways into public streets. Following discussion regarding public communication and resident expectations, the committee voted to receive the paper and place it on file.
